info.description: REST API for the pet-messenger backend: auth, conversations, messages, calls, push notifications, and end-to-end encryption key exchange.
info.title: pet-messenger API

post.description: Verifies credentials and responds with a new session payload (access + refresh tokens).
Revokes the session tied to the given refresh token.
Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new session payload (new access + refresh tokens).
Creates a new user account and responds with the same session payload Login would produce.

get.description: Returns the route's call's encrypted session key, wrapped for the caller's own recipient device, once the owning device has published it.
get.summary: Get my wrapped copy of a call's session key

403.description: not a conversation member, or device not trusted

404.description: active call not found, or key not ready

409.description: call key owner is no longer trusted

put.description: Publishes the route's call's encrypted session key, wrapped once for every trusted device in the call's conversation. The caller must be the call's initiator.
put.summary: Publish a call's encrypted session key

parameters.description: Owner device id and per-recipient envelopes
parameters.name: request

403.description: not a conversation member, not the initiator, or owner device not trusted

post.description: Ends the route's call. Ending an already-ended call is a no-op 204, not an error.

403.description: not permitted to end this call

post.description: Joins the route's already-live call. An invalid or missing requested role falls back to "publisher"; the request body itself is optional.

404.description: call not found or not live

403.description: not permitted, or cannot target self
not permitted, or cannot target self
not permitted, or cannot target self

get.description: Returns a page of the authenticated user's conversation inbox, newest activity first.

parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor
parameters.name: cursor

get.description: Returns a page of public channels, optionally filtered by a search query.

parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor
parameters.name: cursor

post.description: Returns the existing direct conversation with the given user, creating it if none exists.
Starts a new call for the route's conversation, or joins its already-live call.

409.description: call not supported, or conversation archived

get.description: Returns the route's conversation's live call and current participant roster.

404.description: conversation or live call not found

post.description: Lets a creator-heir admin claim the vacant creator seat.
post.summary: Claim the creator seat of a conversation

get.description: Returns every trusted device belonging to any member of the route's conversation, for a caller who is themselves a member. Unlike List, the public key is included -- the client needs it to encrypt a new message's key to every trusted recipient device.
get.summary: List trusted devices in a conversation

parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor
parameters.name: cursor

post.summary: Add a member to a conversation

patch.description: Handles the creator stepping down (admin_tier: "") or restoring themselves (admin_tier: "creator_admin").

parameters.description: New admin tier (empty string clears it)
parameters.name: request

delete.summary: Remove a member from a conversation

403.description: not permitted to remove this member

parameters.description: New admin tier (empty string clears it)
parameters.name: request

403.description: not permitted to set this tier

get.description: Returns a page of the route's conversation history, keyset-paginated by seq.

parameters.description: Return messages after this seq (forward page)
parameters.name: after_seq

parameters.description: Return messages before this seq (backward page)
parameters.name: before_seq

post.description: Posts a new text message to the route's conversation.

403.description: not a member, or cannot post

patch.description: Replaces the content of the route's message. Only the original author may edit.

post.description: Persists the last message currently visible to the authenticated user. The client sends one cursor per newly loaded page, not one request per individual message.
post.summary: Mark a conversation read through a message

get.description: Returns a page of the authenticated user's notifications, newest first, along with their current unread count.

parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor
parameters.name: cursor

post.description: Marks every notification of the authenticated user up through through_cursor as read; an absent or empty cursor marks everything read.
Registers the authenticated actor's device push endpoint for notification delivery.

delete.description: Removes the authenticated actor's device push endpoint.

patch.description: Updates display name and/or username. At least one field must be set.

post.description: Multipart form upload, field name "avatar". Accepts png, jpeg, or webp, up to 2MiB.

parameters.description: Avatar image (png, jpeg, or webp; max 2MiB)
parameters.name: avatar

get.description: Returns every non-revoked device belonging to the authenticated user's own account.

post.description: Registers a new e2ee device for the authenticated user, or returns their own already-registered device unchanged if the same id/keys were submitted again.

409.description: device id conflict or already registered

post.description: Trusts the authenticated user's own pending device on the vouching of one of their already-trusted devices.

403.description: approver not trusted, invalid signature, or cannot approve

get.summary: Get a user profile by username

BearerAuth.description: Access token issued by POST /auth/login or /auth/register, sent as "Bearer <token>".
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
